A competency credential resolves a permitted exact mastery decision through the competencies owner.
A credential issued for a programme qualification resolves exact approved qualification evidence through the programmes owner.
Require the exact tested edition, isolated runtime origin, and browser profile. Package metadata alone is insufficient.
A grade-based signal requires authorized records. No source makes the feature unavailable, not a negative intervention signal.
An approved grade-contributing assessment binding needs exact GradeItem and accepted evidence owner contracts. Ungraded delivery does not require the gradebook.
An official report or transcript that cites grade results requires exact released revisions. A qualification or competency credential can have a separate supported source profile.
Enable a reviewed protected history profile separately from editable curriculum import.
An item that uses managed media needs exact approved curriculum asset versions and protected storage. Text-only bank authoring does not require media references.
A tool score enters approved evidence and cannot publish official grades directly.
Enable only the reviewed deployment and service scopes. Grade return additionally needs approved academic binding.
A provider-backed immutable document requires its adapter and rights. Native protected assets remain usable.
A managed media provider is required only for the explicitly selected media profile.
Manual evidence enters through the accepted evidence owner for the exact enrollment and official grade line without requiring a native attempt.
Provider or registered local model profile is required only for that assistive feature. Native editing and published delivery remain independent.
Binding and launching an approved native assessment needs the exact definition and delivery. An ordinary native lesson needs no assessment service.
Native marking resolves the exact sealed attempt and response evidence. Manual and package evidence intake can run without an assessment attempt owner.
An accepted package outcome enters authorized evidence and official grade processing without requiring a native assessment attempt.
A registered programme can be authored without grades. A grade-derived credit rule requires exact accepted and released evidence.
Require an approved feed authority. Native rostering does not rely on provider connectivity.
Require a tested edition generator and destination projection profile. Existing package playback is not proof of export capability.
A source authoring plan that includes assessment proposals needs their native authoring and assembly owners. An ordinary course drafting plan does not.
Enable the verified reconstruction profile when an archive transfer reaches required assessment objects. Source document extraction is independent.
